$comment: The attributable reading of query expansion (S18): two dispatches at one commit, 121 MR questions each, four repetitions. Produced by `tools/expansion-reading.py` from the two artifacts, not typed. The first version of this file reported +4 of 121 -- that was repetition 0, which is what `questions[].correct` turns out to be; see `fieldIdentity` and tracking report 142.16.

pair.why: S17 paired a 2026-11-20 treatment against a 2026-11-17 control and read the difference as one flag; fifty of 379 non-target prompts had moved with identical evidence bytes, which is a renderer drift. This pair is one dispatch after another at one sha, so the only difference is the flag -- and the artifacts carry the sha that proves it (AblationReport.revision, added in the same round).

mr.estimator: four-repetition mean, exact sign-flip over per-question count differences

firstRepetition.$comment: The retracted reading. `questions[].correct` reproduces repetition 0 on 121 of 121 questions in both arms, so every number this campaign published from that field before round 145 is one repetition's. Kept because a retraction that deletes its own number cannot be checked.

baselineSide.$comment: The reference pipeline inside each run. The first version of this file called it a deterministic side that reproduced question for question at 105; that was wrong, and the artifact says so: its four repetitions land on 105/107/102/105 in the control and 105/105/103/103 in the treatment. It uses the same LLM reader, so it is stochastic, and the identical 105 in both artifacts' `baseline.metrics.correct` is repetition 0 of both, not a reproduced run.
baselineSide.note: This is the noise floor this pair does have to construct: the same configuration dispatched twice moved by -0.75 questions, 6 won against 7 lost. A treatment delta of +1.75 is the same order.

memoryArmAgainstReference.$comment: Where the gap to the published frontier actually is. Both arms' memory side is below the reference pipeline on MR, which is the number that does not move when the flag moves.
memoryArmAgainstReference.reading: The artifact's own t-test over four run scores says significant in both arms; the question-level sign-flip does not, because 121 questions resolve about +/-8 points and the discordant counts are 26 and 29. The honest statement is the point estimate and the resolution, not the smaller of the two p-values.

bill.note: The 8,600 ceiling was written for the 500-question file. An MR-only run gives every question the 48,460-character multi-session room, so its per-question bill IS the multi-session bill -- 13,019 on the control, which the ceiling is already below. Registered as mis-scaled in PREREGISTRATION 13.377.11 before this artifact existed; E2' (ratio, <= 1.15) was registered at the same time and reads 0.992.

receipt.note: The product's own census, both sides. 484 queries against 484 indexes on the control (it expands nothing) and 1,932 against the same 484 on the treatment: four queries per index, one per question per repetition. The phrases reached the ranking.

E3.measured: 0 of 0 non-MR prompts moved, 0 capabilities below floor
E3.threshold: 0 moved, no capability more than 2 below
E3.note: Vacuous on an MR-only roster and recorded as such rather than as evidence: there is no other cell to leak into, and E0 is what carries the same-code claim.

disposition.licence: PREREGISTRATION 13.377.9 row 3: E1' fail with E0/E2'/E4 pass licenses the close, including the window reorder's premise.
disposition.whatTheDeltaIs: **+1.75 questions on the four-repetition mean** (+1.45pp): 8 questions won, 5 lost, 108 ties, exact sign-flip p = 0.3901. Not +4: that was repetition 0, and the correction is tracking report 142.16. Below the five questions the registration asked for, and the same order as the -0.75-question movement the reference pipeline shows between the two dispatches.
disposition.whatItSettles: S17 could not answer whether the mechanism works: its delta was two code versions. This pair's delta is one flag. The answer is that the mechanism does not buy a measurable amount of MR accuracy, and the sentences it adds reach the ranking (1,932 queries against 484 indexes, zero refusals).
disposition.whatItLeaves: The memory arm is still below the reference pipeline that uses the same reader: -4.55pp on the control and -2.48pp on the treatment. That deficit is 3.5 to 6 times the size of what the expansion bought, and it is the next thing to read.
